endpoint: right-ALM behavioral recovery versus control-trial bilateral ALM coupling

studies.study: Chen et al. 2024 DANDI external test

interpretation: Descriptive Fisher-z synthesis only. The 2024 right-side endpoint was prespecified but secondary, and its two-side Bonferroni-adjusted P value was 0.0832; this pooled calculation is not confirmatory evidence and does not relabel the frozen 2024 primary test as successful.
